name: Can Cute Clothes Alone Really Save The World !?
source:
Four girls are brought together by a fairy, who claims to be sent to Earth by a goddess named "Mother Dressmaker". They are sent on a magical girl mission to prevent the end of the world in February of 1999, with the condition that it must be done by sewing cute clothes.

[From [url=https://x.com/nekotorine/status/2017722192461500837]X[/url]]
